product.description: Monoprice™Low Profile Fixed TV Wall MountFits TVs 42 in to 90 in, Max Weight 165 lbs, VESA Patterns up to 600×400The Monoprice™ Low Profile Fixed TV Wall Mount is designed to accommodate televisions with a VESA® pattern ranging from 150×100 to 600×400. It's an excellent choice for displays spanning 42" up to a whopping 90" in size. Crafted from high-strength, cold-formed steel, this wall mount ensures safe and reliable support for weights of up to 165 lbs.Monoprice TV mounts undergo rigorous lab testing, doubling their rated weight capacity. In this case, the mount can handle over 300 lbs without damage. Rest assured that your TV is securely mounted.The Low Profile Fixed TV Wall Mount includes all the essential mounting hardware. Whether installing on brick, concrete, or wood stud walls, you won't need to make unnecessary trips to the local hardware store.Notable features of this wall mount include a low-profile mounting, holding the back of the TV only 1.1" off the wall. Should you need to reposition the TV or access cables at the back, the spring-tensioned locking lugs come equipped with quick-release pull tabs. These allow you to tilt the TV up and out of the way or simply remove it when necessary.Fits VESA® patterns from 150×100 to 600×400Designed for 42" ∼ 90" displaysSupports up to 165 lbsLow profile mounting- the back of the TV is just 1.1" from the wallSpring-tensioned locking lugs with quick-release pull tabs for simple TV removalMounting hardware includes mounting template and bubble levelMounts to brick, concrete, or wood stud wallsCold-formed, high-strength steel construction EXTRA LARGE SIZE AND WEIGHT CAPACITYThe Monoprice™ Low Profile Fixed TV Wall Mount is compatible with VESA patterns up to 600 mm × 400 mm, and supports a maximum weight capacity of 165 lbs, making it perfect for TVs up to 90" in size. Like all Monoprice TV mounts, the Low Profile Fixed TV Wall Mount has undergone rigorous lab testing, holding double its rated weight at over 300 lbs without damage to the mount. LOW PROFILE MOUNTINGThe Low Profile Fixed TV Wall Mount is an excellent choice for those seeking a sturdy and space-saving solution for mounting a display at eye level—the slim, low-profile design positions your TV a mere 1.1" from the wall. EASY ACCESS DESIGNThe mount features spring-tensioned locking lugs with quick-release pull tabs for effortless TV adjustments.
